subject: Final-mile ownership handoff and credit path — MAP rebaseline request
messages:
From: Dan Miller <dan.miller@helixhealth.io>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Lisa Chang <lisa.chang@helixhealth.io>
Date: Sun, 18 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP & go-live window — procurement constraints

Olga,

Quick note from procurement: our security team has flagged two outstanding items in the SOC2 evidence (retention config and audit log retention policy) that block our acceptance window. Procurement is pushing the internal signoff out by ~3–4 weeks unless we provide the updated artifacts and a revised MAP.

We want to keep Redwood in the plan, but we need a formal update to the MAP that: 1) extends the acceptance window, 2) lists the exact deliverables and owners for the SOC2 items, and 3) includes remediation commitments if acceptance slips again.

Also, finance asked whether Redwood would consider a short-term commercial concession if the close slips past Oct 31 — they specifically mentioned a 10–15% first-month credit to offset their internal costs. Can you confirm whether that’s something you can commit to, and who on your side would sign off?

Thanks —
Dan
Dan Miller
CTO, HelixHealth
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Grace Oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: MAP & go-live window — procurement constraints

Ben / Grace — forwarding HelixHealth ask. Key points:
- Procurement will push signoff ~3–4 weeks unless we provide
  updated SOC2 artifacts and an owner-driven remediation plan.
- Customer requests an updated MAP that clearly lists owners, dates, and fallbacks.
- They also asked whether Redwood can offer a commercial concession (10–15% first-month credit) in the event the close slips past 10/31.

Proposal (triage):
1) Send the SOC2 summary and a short remediation plan (attached SOC2_summary.pdf).
2) Share an updated MAP (attached map_draft_v3.pdf) that:
   - Re-baselines acceptance milestones to a conservative window (suggest 11/18 final acceptance),
   - Calls out remedial owners (Redwood: Ben for runtime, Olga for infra, Helix: Lisa for procurement).
3) Offer a conditional commercial concession: 10% first-month credit guaranteed; escalate to 15% only if the slip is due to Redwood operational failings (we should avoid open-ended credits).

Ben — I included a draft risk register (risk_log.xlsx) in case we need to call out mitigation steps. Can you confirm whether Dedicated capacity can be pinned for the new window (11/18) and whether the 10% credit is within your tolerance to approve? Grace — if this needs exec sign-off, please advise the approval path.

Thanks,
Olga

--
Olga Petrov
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Grace Oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: MAP & go-live window — procurement constraints

Received — I reviewed the draft MAP and the SOC2 summary. Notes:
- Dedicated capacity: we can pin a soft-reservation for the candidate window (11/05–11/25) but hard commits require a 30% reserve fee per our Dedicated policy. We should avoid an unnecessary commit unless the customer signs the amendment.
- Risk register highlights two tech risks that could push run-rate: KV cache tuning and model quantization QA. Those are marked in risk_log.xlsx with owners and mitigations.
- Commercial concession: 10% first-month credit is approvable within the sales budget. 15% requires Sales Ops/Rev approval (I can route if needed).

Recommended next steps (internal):
1) Send Helix the updated MAP and SOC2 summary now.
2) Offer a conditional 10% first-month credit in writing, with an explicit clause that escalates to 15% only after a documented Redwood failure and executive approval.
3) Prepare a one-page amendment (DocuSign) that covers the MAP rebaseline and the credit term; leave Dedicated commit language optional pending amendment signature.

Attachment: risk_log.xlsx (contains mitigations and owner ETA).

Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Customer Reliability | Redwood Inference
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Dan Miller <dan.miller@helixhealth.io>, Lisa Chang <lisa.chang@helixhealth.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: MAP update + conditional concession — proposed rebaseline

Dan / Lisa —

Thanks for the flag. Attached is an updated MAP (map_draft_v3.pdf) and a short SOC2 evidence summary (SOC2_summary.pdf). The MAP lists owners, target dates and fallbacks — Redwood commits Olga (me) for overall delivery, Ben for runtime stabilization and model QA.

Commercial: Redwood can commit to a conditional 10% credit on the first month of service if the close slips beyond Oct 31 due to factors under Redwood’s control. We will escalate to 15% only if an agreed post-mortem shows Redwood was negligent in meeting remediation milestones. The concession will be included in a short amendment (DocuSign link to follow).

Proposed MAP re-baseline (conservative):
- Start: 11/02 —— integration smoke and SOC2 verification
- Final acceptance window: 11/11–11/18
- Fallback: if acceptance not achieved by 11/18, run weekly stabilization sprints and document remedial steps; credit clause triggers if issue is Redwood-caused.

Please confirm you can accept the timeline and the conditional credit language. If you want a firmer Dedicated reservation we can include optional language in the amendment but would need a signature to avoid capacity recycle.

Thanks,
Olga

From: Grace Oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Dan Miller <dan.miller@helixhealth.io>, Lisa Chang <lisa.chang@helixhealth.io>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 22 Oct 2026 17:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP update + conditional concession — proposed rebaseline

Dan / Lisa / Olga —

Thanks for the clear update. I’ve reviewed the MAP and the SOC2 summary. Redwood will approve the following:

1) MAP re-baseline to final acceptance window 11/11–11/18.
2) Conditional commercial concession: 10% credit on month one automatically if acceptance slips past 10/31. Escalation to 15% requires an internal review and explicit sign-off by Redwood leadership.
3) We will not hard-reserve Dedicated capacity without an executed amendment; however, we will provide a soft reservation narrative in the amendment and prioritize capacity if signature follows within 10 business days.

Olga — please prepare a 1-page amendment (DocuSign) that captures: rebaseline dates, the conditional 10% credit language, ownership matrix, and the optional Dedicated reservation language. Once you have the DocuSign link, share it with Dan / Lisa and cc Ben.

Dan — thank you for the transparency. Let’s treat the SOC2 items as high priority; if Helix can provide acceptance criteria for the retention & audit log items we’ll align remediation owners and dates in the amendment.

Grace Oconnor
VP, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
